title: Mass of a weighted ray current in a ball centred at 0 (parent step 8, mass of C)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, C ∈ 𝒟_1(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ 1), R an integer multiplicity triple in ℝ^P (IMRep univ 1) with R.Represents C, F ⊆ ℝ^P a finite set of unit vectors and m : ℝ^P → ℤ such that R.measure(A) = Σ_{e∈F} |m(e)|·ℒ¹((0,∞) ∩ {t : te ∈ A}) for every Borel set A ⊆ ℝ^P. Then for every r ∈ ℝ, M_{B_r(0)}(C) = C.massOn(B_r(0)) = ofReal((Σ_{e∈F} |m(e)|)·r) in [0, ∞] (B_r(0) the open ball; both sides are 0 when r ≤ 0).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1) (F : Finset (Euclid P)), (∀ e ∈ F, ‖e‖ = 1) → ∀ m : Euclid P → ℤ, R.Represents C → (∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → R.measure A = ∑ e ∈ F, ENNReal.ofReal |(m e : ℝ)| * volume (Ioi (0 : ℝ) ∩ (fun t : ℝ => t • e) ⁻¹' A)) → ∀ r : ℝ, C.massOn (ball (0 : Euclid P) r) = ENNReal.ofReal ((∑ e ∈ F, |(m e : ℝ)|) * r)
